steps.observation: You have 900 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism – the build-up of large standing armies and navies (an “arms race”) that made nations quick to resort to force.  
2. Alliance system – binding treaties (e.g. Triple Entente vs. Triple Alliance) that turned a regional dispute into a general war.  
3. Nationalism – intense national pride and ethnic tensions (especially in the Balkans) that encouraged aggressive policies and mutual distrust.
